# Changes in BASE PRESETS v5.0

- Finalized the collection as the baseline preset pack.
- Retuned only shotgun and rocket launcher.
- Shotgun: lower EQ edges, stronger 25-300 Hz share, longer low/mid envelopes,
  less upper dryness and denser bounded FIR reflections.
- Rocket launcher: stronger 20-300 Hz share, longer pressure envelope, darker
  upper balance and FIR reflections extending to 180 ms.
- Kept pistol, Magnum, metralla, Gatling and sniper parameters unchanged from
  their approved HEAVY HIT v4 package values.
- No new source, filter family, effect, feedback path or allocation mechanism.
